body.p: Applicant requests that the above amendments be entered prior to further examination of this application. Applicant amends the specification as shown above to correct typographical errors in various paragraphs and Claim 5. No new matter has been introduced by these amendments.

Applicant respectfully submits that the present application is in condition for examination on the merits. Applicant invites the Examiner to telephone the undersigned if the Examiner has any questions regarding this Amendment or if a telephone call could help expedite prosecution of the subject application. The Commissioner is authorized to charge any fees which may be due or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 19-28 14. This statement does NOT authorize charge of the issue fee.
